contracts.file_mode_output: normalized Bash source text; no structured source-position or resolved-target records

control.policy: Untraced original bin/bats test; same interpreter path and write sandbox; no BASH_ENV or oracle hooks; failures retained

independence.native_alias_change: exactly one actual driver/target pair changes from target_one to target_two

lookup.policy: Independent syntax selects source sites; native namespace answers establish availability in the recorded union, not context-sensitive native reference/caller truth. No whole-source grade or runtime coverage inferred.

bats.load_contract: session-wide union of tracked Bash libraries from package files manifest; no test body loaded

lookup.tool: GNU Bash type / compgen / declare namespace audit

policy: Offline review correction: native frames enumerate all in-root pairs; A recall uses only unchanged eligible caller-file membership, and syntax gates coverage only. Rejected phases contribute no accepted counts. Original native execution/proof hashes are pinned to historical_capture_revision; current decoder and checks are separately hashed.

runtime.scope: A executed native pair recall on unchanged eligible caller files; all in-root native identities and outside-caller-scope counts disclosed; syntax selects coverage only; separate C source-pair comparison with independently selected syntax scope; no whole-written L2/L3 grade

bats.observed_source_diagnostic_tier: C: independent syntax selects the literal-site population; native opened filenames are executed facts, not whole-source enumeration
bats.policy: Timed/signalled/source-modified child events are rejected; every original site retained; zero source-literal denominator is unmeasured, not perfect coverage or an A-tier promotion
bats.runtime_environment_policy: fresh per-phase HOME/temp/npm/XDG roots; host shell/NVM/Git/npm overrides removed; no PROFILE override; native system mktemp may remain unavailable under lane-only writes
bats.runtime_precision: unmeasured: unexecuted predictions are not judged

nvm.observed_source_diagnostic_tier: C: independent syntax selects the literal-site population; native opened filenames are executed facts, not whole-source enumeration
nvm.policy: Timed/signalled/source-modified child events are rejected; every original site retained; zero source-literal denominator is unmeasured, not perfect coverage or an A-tier promotion
nvm.runtime_environment_policy: fresh per-phase HOME/temp/npm/XDG roots; host shell/NVM/Git/npm overrides removed; no PROFILE override; native system mktemp may remain unavailable under lane-only writes
nvm.runtime_precision: unmeasured: unexecuted predictions are not judged

scip.scoring_tier: C product-range-assisted pair diagnostic; independent native occurrence audit does not use product output

audit.pair_diagnostic_tier: C: generic scorer uses product caller ranges when native enclosing ranges are missing; independent raw occurrence coverage is separate
audit.population: all original shfmt CallExpr sites, dynamic included; only native function/system-symbol occurrences attest literal command targets; no source/variable occurrence counted as a resolved call

audit.pair_diagnostic_tier: C: generic scorer uses product caller ranges when native enclosing ranges are missing; independent raw occurrence coverage is separate
audit.population: all original shfmt CallExpr sites, dynamic included; only native function/system-symbol occurrences attest literal command targets; no source/variable occurrence counted as a resolved call

bats.tier: C source-contract diagnostic only; no native truth or score filtering
